properties.name: app.email.mode
properties.description: Selects the provider-independent email verification delivery mode.

properties.name: app.email.verification-page-url
properties.description: Absolute frontend page URL used to build email verification links.

properties.name: app.email.password-recovery-page-url
properties.description: Absolute frontend page URL used to build password recovery links. Defaults to the local non-production reset page when omitted.

properties.name: app.email.sender.address
properties.description: Required sender address when app.email.mode is SMTP.

properties.name: app.email.sender.name
properties.description: Required display name for the SMTP sender.

properties.name: app.email.sender.reply-to
properties.description: Optional reply-to address for SMTP verification messages.

properties.name: app.email.smtp.host
properties.description: Required SMTP host when app.email.mode is SMTP.

properties.name: app.email.smtp.port
properties.description: SMTP TCP port between 1 and 65535 when SMTP mode is active.

properties.name: app.email.smtp.username
properties.description: SMTP username required only when app.email.smtp.auth is true.

properties.name: app.email.smtp.password
properties.description: SMTP password required only when app.email.smtp.auth is true.

properties.name: app.email.smtp.connect-timeout
properties.description: Positive SMTP connection timeout when SMTP mode is active.

properties.name: app.email.smtp.read-timeout
properties.description: Positive SMTP read timeout when SMTP mode is active.

properties.name: app.email.smtp.write-timeout
properties.description: Positive SMTP write timeout when SMTP mode is active.
